card.statement:
Let $\ell_1,\ldots, \ell_n\in \Z$ such that $\ell_i\neq \ell_j$ for all $i\neq j$. Then the following equations hold in $V(\zeta)$.

- Let $t\in \Z_{>0}$, and $m_1,\ldots, m_t\in \Z$. If there exists some $j=1,\ldots, t$, for which $m_j\neq -\ell_i$ for all $i=1,\ldots, n$, then

\[
x_\alpha(m_1)\cdots x_\alpha(m_t)x_{-\alpha}(\ell_1)\cdots x_{-\alpha}(\ell_n)1_\zeta=0.
\]

- If $t\leq n$, then

\begin{multline*}
x_\alpha(-\ell_t)\cdots x_\alpha(-\ell_1)x_{-\alpha}(\ell_1)\cdots x_{-\alpha}(\ell_n)1_\zeta \\
= \prod_{i=1}^n \zeta (h_\alpha-\ell_i (x_\alpha | x_{-\alpha})K)x_{-\alpha}(\ell_{t+1})\cdots x_{-\alpha}(\ell_n) 1_\zeta.
\end{multline*}

In particular,

\[
x_\alpha(-\ell_n)\cdots x_\alpha(-\ell_1)x_{-\alpha}(\ell_1)\cdots x_{-\alpha}(\ell_n)1_\zeta=\prod_{i=1}^n \zeta (h_\alpha-\ell_i (x_\alpha | x_{-\alpha})K) 1_\zeta.
\]

- If $t>n$, then

\[
x_\alpha(m_1)\cdots x_\alpha(m_t)x_{-\alpha}(\ell_1)\cdots x_{-\alpha}(\ell_n)1_\zeta=0,
\]

for all $m_1,\ldots, m_t\in \Z$.
card.label: Corollary 1

paper.title: Highest weight modules for affine Lie superalgebras
paper.abstract: We describe Borel and parabolic subalgebras of affine Lie superalgebras and study the Verma type modules associated to such subalgebras. We give necessary and sufficient conditions under which these modules are simple.
